lines.text: Four score and seven years ago our fathers brought forth on this continent a new nation,
conceived in Liberty, and dedicated to the proposition that all men are created equal.
Now we are engaged in a great civil war,
testing whether that nation, or any nation so conceived and so dedicated, can long endure.

pieces.title: Speech to the Troops at Tilbury
pieces.title_hant: Speech to the Troops at Tilbury
pieces.author: Elizabeth I

lines.text: I know I have the body of a weak and feeble woman;
but I have the heart and stomach of a king, and of a king of England too.
That man over there says that women need to be helped into carriages,
and lifted over ditches, and to have the best place everywhere.
Shall I compare thee to a summer's day?
Thou art more lovely and more temperate:
Rough winds do shake the darling buds of May,
And summer's lease hath all too short a date.
Tyger Tyger, burning bright,
In the forests of the night;
What immortal hand or eye,
Could frame thy fearful symmetry?
Maître Corbeau, sur un arbre perché,
Tenait en son bec un fromage.
Maître Renard, par l'odeur alléché,
Lui tint à peu près ce langage :
Demain, dès l'aube, à l'heure où blanchit la campagne,
Je partirai. Vois-tu, je sais que tu m'attends.
J'irai par la forêt, j'irai par la montagne.
Je ne puis demeurer loin de toi plus longtemps.
¿Qué es poesía?, dices mientras clavas
en mi pupila tu pupila azul.
¡Qué es poesía! ¿Y tú me lo preguntas?
Poesía... eres tú.
Caminante, son tus huellas el camino y nada más;
caminante, no hay camino, se hace camino al andar.
床前明月光，
疑是地上霜。
举头望明月，
低头思故乡。
春眠不觉晓，
处处闻啼鸟。
夜来风雨声，
花落知多少。

drills.title: être — present
drills.note: Full paradigm of the most important irregular verb.

drills.title: avoir — present
drills.note: Full paradigm; many French idioms use avoir where English uses 'to be'.

drills.title: aller and faire — present
drills.note: Two irregular verbs used constantly: aller (to go) and faire (to do/make).

drills.title: pouvoir and vouloir — present
drills.note: Modal verbs followed by an infinitive; note the stem change nous/vous vs. singular.

drills.title: Regular -er, -ir, -re verbs
drills.note: Three regular conjugation groups in the present tense.

drills.title: Reflexive verbs

phrases.text: je me lève à sept heures

drills.note: The reflexive pronoun (me/te/se/nous/vous/se) comes before the verb.

drills.title: Passé composé — avoir vs être
drills.note: Most verbs take avoir; movement and reflexive verbs take être and agree with the subject.

drills.title: Imparfait
drills.note: Past habits, descriptions and states; the stem comes from nous + ending -ais/-ais/-ait/-ions/-iez/-aient.

drills.title: Futur proche and futur simple
drills.note: aller + infinitive for the near future; endings -rai/-ras/-ra/-rons/-rez/-ront for the simple future.

drills.title: Conditional
drills.note: Politeness, wishes and hypotheses; future stem plus imperfect endings.

drills.title: Subjunctive triggers

phrases.text: je suis content que vous soyez là
il faut que nous fassions attention

drills.note: The subjunctive follows il faut que, vouloir que, bien que and expressions of emotion.

drills.title: Negation: ne…pas / jamais / rien / plus

phrases.text: je ne mange jamais de viande

drills.note: ne goes before the verb, the second word after it; ne becomes n' before a vowel.

drills.title: Questions: est-ce que, inversion, interrogatives
drills.note: Three ways to ask: intonation, est-ce que, or inversion; plus the common question words.

drills.title: Object pronouns: le/la/les, y, en
drills.note: Pronouns go before the conjugated verb; y replaces à + place, en replaces de + noun or quantity.

drills.title: Pronoun order: me/te + le, le + lui, y + en
drills.note: Order before the verb: me/te/nous/vous, then le/la/les, then lui/leur, then y, then en.

drills.title: Gender, number and possessives
drills.note: Articles, adjectives and possessives agree with the noun; mon/ton/son is used before a vowel sound.

drills.title: Partitive articles: du, de la, de l', des

phrases.text: je ne veux pas de lait

drills.note: Use du/de la/de l' for an unspecified amount; after a negation or quantity use de/d'.

drills.title: à and de, contractions au/du/aux/des
drills.note: à + le = au, à + les = aux, de + le = du, de + les = des; countries use en.

drills.title: Numbers, time and dates
drills.note: Tricky number systems (70, 80, 90) and telling the time with 'et quart / moins le quart'.

drills.title: Liaison and elision
drills.note: A silent final consonant is linked to a following vowel; je/le/que drop their vowel before a vowel sound.

drills.title: Imperative
drills.note: Commands and requests; tu/nous/vous forms, -er verbs lose the s in tu form, negative wraps ne…pas around the verb.

drills.title: Comparatives and superlatives
drills.note: plus/moins/aussi + adjective + que; bon becomes meilleur, bien becomes mieux.

drills.title: Relative pronouns: qui, que, où

phrases.text: le jour où je suis né

drills.note: qui replaces the subject, que the direct object, où a place or time.

drills.title: ser vs estar
drills.note: ser for identity and traits, estar for location and states; the pairs es/está change meaning.

drills.title: ser — present
drills.note: Full paradigm of ser: identity, origin, profession.

drills.title: tener — present
drills.note: Stem change e to ie, irregular yo form; many idioms use tener (hambre, razón, prisa).

drills.title: ir and hacer — present
drills.note: Two core irregular verbs; hacer has an irregular yo form (hago).

drills.title: poder and querer — present
drills.note: Stem-changing verbs (o to ue, e to ie) followed by an infinitive.

drills.title: Regular -ar, -er, -ir verbs
drills.note: Three conjugation groups; the subject pronoun is usually dropped.

drills.title: Reflexive verbs
drills.note: The pronoun me/te/se/nos/os/se comes before the verb and matches the subject.

drills.title: Pretérito perfecto vs indefinido
drills.note: haber + participle for recent or connected past; indefinido for finished moments in the past.

drills.title: Imperfecto
drills.note: Past habits and descriptions; only ser, ir and ver are irregular.

drills.title: ir a + infinitive and futuro simple
drills.note: ir a + infinitive for plans; the simple future adds endings to the infinitive (some irregular stems).

drills.title: Conditional
drills.note: Politeness, wishes and hypotheses; infinitive plus -ía endings.

drills.title: Subjunctive triggers
drills.note: Subjunctive after querer que, esperar que, ojalá, es posible que, and in cuando clauses about the future.

drills.title: Negation: no, nunca, nada, nadie
drills.note: No goes before the verb; negative words after the verb require no as well.

drills.title: Question words
drills.note: Written accents on interrogatives; inverted question mark at the start.

drills.title: Direct and indirect object pronouns
drills.note: lo/la/los/las for direct, le/les for indirect; placed before the conjugated verb.

drills.title: Pronoun order: se lo, me lo
drills.note: Indirect before direct; le/les becomes se before lo/la/los/las.

drills.title: Gender, number and possessives
drills.note: Articles and adjectives agree in gender and number; buen shortens before a masculine singular noun.

drills.title: por vs para
drills.note: por for cause, route and time of day; para for purpose, destination and recipient.

drills.title: Numbers, time and dates
drills.note: Telling time uses es la una / son las; dates use el + number + de + month.

drills.title: Stress shifts and tilde pairs
drills.note: Stress or a written accent changes meaning: papá/papa, hablo/habló, tú/tu, él/el, té/te, sé/se.

drills.title: gustar and similar verbs
drills.note: The verb agrees with the thing liked, not the person: me gusta el café, me gustan los libros.

drills.title: Imperative (tú)
drills.note: Affirmative tú commands; irregular: ven, di, haz, sal, pon; pronouns attach to the end.

drills.title: Comparatives and superlatives
drills.note: más/menos…que, tan…como, tanto…como; irregular mejor and peor.

drills.title: 是 — A is B

phrases.pinyin: nǐ shì měi guó rén ma

drills.note: 是 links two nouns (A = B); negate with 不是, no 'to be' with adjectives.

drills.title: 有 / 没有 — have, there is

phrases.pinyin: wǒ yǒu yí gè gē gē
zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī běn shū
wǒ jiā yǒu sān gè rén

drills.note: 有 = have / there is; negate only with 没有 (never 不有).

drills.title: Pronouns and plural 们

phrases.pinyin: nǐ men shì lǎo shī ma

drills.note: Add 们 to 我/你/他/她 to make plurals.

drills.title: 在 — be located

phrases.pinyin: xǐ shǒu jiān zài nà biān

drills.note: 在 + place says where something or someone is.

drills.title: Adjectives with 很
drills.note: Adjectives act as verbs; 很 is a light link, not 'very', in plain statements.

drills.title: 想 / 要 / 喜欢 + verb

phrases.pinyin: wǒ yào yī bēi kā fēi
tā xǐ huān tīng yīn yuè

drills.note: 想 want to, 要 want / will, 喜欢 like to; verb follows directly.

drills.title: 这 / 那 / 哪 — this, that, which
drills.note: Demonstrative + measure word + noun.

drills.title: Age and family

phrases.pinyin: wǒ jīn nián sān shí suì
wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén
nǐ yǒu xiōng dì jiě mèi ma
wǒ yǒu yí gè mèi mèi

drills.note: Age uses 岁; family size uses 口; 几 for small counts.

drills.title: 的 — possession

phrases.pinyin: wǒ mā mā de péng yǒu

drills.note: A 的 B = A's B; 的 can drop with close relations (我妈妈).

drills.title: 的 — modifying a noun
drills.note: Describing words and verb phrases go before 的 and the noun.

drills.title: 个 本 张 杯
drills.note: Number + measure word + noun: 个 general, 本 books, 张 flat things, 杯 cups.

drills.title: 只 件 条 双 辆 把
drills.note: 只 small animals, 件 clothes and matters, 条 long things, 双 pairs, 辆 vehicles, 把 handled things.

drills.title: 这 / 那 + number + measure word
drills.note: Between 这/那 and the noun you need a measure word.

drills.title: 一点儿 一些 一碗 一块
drills.note: Quantity words: 一点儿/一些 a bit, 碗 bowl, 块 piece/yuan, 位 polite person.

drills.title: 了 — completed action

phrases.pinyin: tā mǎi le yī běn shū
wǒ hē le liǎng bēi chá
wǒ chī le fàn jiù qù

drills.note: Verb + 了 marks a completed action; with an object give a quantity or add a second 了.

drills.title: 了 — change of state

phrases.pinyin: tā shì dà xué shēng le
tā huì shuō zhōng wén le

drills.note: Sentence-final 了 signals a new situation.

drills.title: 过 — have ever done

phrases.pinyin: nǐ chī guò jiǎo zi ma
wǒ kàn guò zhè ge diàn yǐng

drills.note: Verb + 过 = have done it before; negate with 没…过.

drills.title: 在 / 正在 — in progress

phrases.pinyin: tā zhèng zài dǎ diàn huà
wǒ méi zài kàn diàn shì
wài miàn zhèng zài xià yǔ

drills.note: 在 or 正在 before the verb = doing it right now; negate with 没在.

drills.title: 着 — continuing state

phrases.pinyin: tā chuān zhe hóng yī fú
qiáng shàng guà zhe yī zhāng huà
zhuō zi shàng fàng zhe yī běn shū
shǒu lǐ ná zhuó shǒu jī

drills.note: Verb + 着 describes a state that continues (door open, wearing, holding).

drills.title: 了 / 过 / 在 compared
drills.note: Same verb, different aspect: finished, experienced, in progress.

drills.title: 不 vs 没
drills.note: 不 for habits, wishes, future, 'to be'; 没 for past events and 有.

drills.title: 吗 questions

phrases.pinyin: tā huì shuō zhōng wén ma

drills.note: Add 吗 to a statement to make a yes/no question.

drills.title: A-not-A questions

phrases.pinyin: nǐ shì bú shì xué shēng
nǐ yǒu méi yǒu shí jiān
nǐ xǐ huān bù xǐ huān zhōng wén

drills.note: Verb + 不 + same verb asks a yes/no question without 吗.

drills.title: Question words 什么 谁 哪儿 几 多少

phrases.pinyin: nǐ yǒu jǐ gè hái zi
nǐ jiào shén me míng zì
nǐ wèi shén me bù qù

drills.note: The question word replaces the answer in place; word order stays the same.

drills.title: More question words

phrases.pinyin: nǐ shén me shí hòu lái
nǎ běn shū shì nǐ de

drills.note: 怎么样 how is it, 几点 what time, 哪 which, 谁 as subject.

drills.title: 呢 and 吧
drills.note: 呢 follows up ('and you?', 'where is…?'); 吧 suggests or guesses.

drills.title: 别 / 不要 / 不用 — don't
drills.note: 别 and 不要 forbid; 不用 means no need.

drills.title: Resultative — 看完, 听懂

phrases.pinyin: wǒ zhǎo dào yào shi le

drills.note: Verb + result (完 finished, 懂 understand, 到 achieved, 好 done well).

drills.title: Resultative — negative with 没

phrases.pinyin: wǒ méi zuò wán zuò yè

drills.note: Negate a resultative with 没: the result did not happen.

drills.title: Directional — 进来, 出去

phrases.pinyin: hái zi pǎo guò lái le

drills.note: 来 toward the speaker, 去 away; 上 下 进 出 回 过 起 give the direction.

drills.title: Potential — 听得懂 / 听不懂
drills.note: 得 or 不 inserted before the result: can / cannot achieve it.

drills.title: Degree — 得

phrases.pinyin: tā shuō zhōng wén shuō dé hěn liú lì
tā chàng gē chàng dé hǎo tīng
nǐ lái de tài zǎo le

drills.note: Verb + 得 + description says how well or how fast something is done.

drills.title: Duration and frequency

phrases.pinyin: wǒ xué le liǎng nián zhōng wén
wǒ děng le nǐ yí gè xiǎo shí
tā shuì le bā gè xiǎo shí
wǒ zài běi jīng zhù le sān tiān
tā kàn le bàn gè xiǎo shí diàn shì

drills.note: Time length and number of times come after the verb.

drills.title: 把 sentences

phrases.pinyin: wǒ bǎ shū fàng zài zhuō zi shàng
tā bǎ fàn chī wán le
nǐ bǎ shǒu jī gěi wǒ
wǒ bǎ yào shi wàng zài jiā lǐ le
qǐng bǎ chuāng hù dǎ kāi
tā bǎ zuò yè zuò wán le
bié bǎ dōng xī nòng diū le

drills.note: 把 + object + verb + result: what you do to a specific thing.

drills.title: 被 passive

phrases.pinyin: wǒ de zì xíng chē bèi tōu le
bēi zi bèi dǎ pò le
tā bèi lǎo shī pī píng le
qián bāo bèi rén ná zǒu le
shǒu jī bèi wǒ nòng diū le
chuāng hù bèi fēng chuī kāi le
dàn gāo bèi dì di chī le
wǒ bèi yǔ lín shī le

drills.note: Receiver + 被 (+ doer) + verb + result; often something unwelcome.

drills.title: 比 — comparison

phrases.pinyin: jīn tiān bǐ zuó tiān lěng
zhè ge bǐ nà ge guì
tā bǐ wǒ dà liǎng suì
zuò dì tiě bǐ zuò gōng jiāo chē kuài
wǒ pǎo dé bǐ tā kuài
zhè běn shū bǐ nà běn shū pián yi

drills.note: A 比 B + adjective; add 更/还 for 'even more', a number after the adjective for the difference.

drills.title: 没有…那么 — not as … as

phrases.pinyin: jīn tiān méi yǒu zuó tiān nà me lěng
zhè ge méi yǒu nà ge guì
wǒ méi yǒu nǐ nà me máng
tā méi yǒu wǒ pǎo dé kuài
běi jīng méi yǒu shàng hǎi dà
zhè jiā diàn méi yǒu nà jiā hǎo

phrases.text: 我的房间没有他的干净
phrases.hant: 我的房間沒有他的乾淨
phrases.pinyin: wǒ de fáng jiān méi yǒu tā de gān jìng

drills.note: A 没有 B (那么) + adjective: A falls short of B.

drills.title: 跟 / 和…一样 — same as

phrases.pinyin: wǒ gēn nǐ yī yàng gāo
zhè ge hé nà ge yī yàng
tā gēn wǒ yī yàng dà

phrases.text: 我的手机跟你的不一样
phrases.hant: 我的手機跟你的不一樣
phrases.pinyin: wǒ de shǒu jī gēn nǐ de bù yí yàng
tā hé mā mā yī yàng piào liàng

drills.note: A 跟 B 一样 (+ adjective); negate with 不一样.

drills.title: 是…的 — when, how, where

phrases.pinyin: wǒ shì zuó tiān lái de
nǐ shì zěn me lái de
tā shì zuò fēi jī lái de
wǒ shì zài běi jīng xué de zhōng wén
nǐ shì shén me shí hòu dào de
wǒ bú shì yí gè rén lái de
tā shì gēn péng yǒu yì qǐ qù de

drills.note: Stresses the time, manner or place of a past event already known to have happened.

drills.title: 会 / 能 / 可以

phrases.pinyin: wǒ jīn tiān bù néng qù
zhè lǐ kě yǐ zuò ma
zhè lǐ bù néng chōu yān

drills.note: 会 learned skill or will, 能 ability or circumstance, 可以 permission.

drills.title: 应该 / 得 / 必须

phrases.pinyin: nǐ yīng gāi duō hē shuǐ
wǒ men bì xū zǎo diǎn ér zǒu
nǐ bù yīng gāi zhè yàng shuō

drills.note: 应该 should, 得 have to, 必须 must.

drills.title: Time words before the verb

phrases.pinyin: wǒ míng tiān qù běi jīng
wǒ men bā diǎn chī fàn
tā měi tiān zǎo shàng pǎo bù
wǒ zuó tiān zài jiā kàn shū
nǐ shén me shí hòu huí jiā
wǒ xià gè xīng qī qù shàng hǎi
tā qù nián lái zhōng guó
wǒ men zhōu mò yì qǐ qù

drills.note: Time words go after the subject and before the verb, never at the end.

drills.title: 在 / 从 / 到 / 给 / 跟 + verb

phrases.pinyin: tā zài tú shū guǎn kàn shū
wǒ gěi mā mā dǎ diàn huà
wǒ gēn péng yǒu qù kàn diàn yǐng

drills.note: Prepositional phrases come before the main verb.

drills.title: Linking clauses

phrases.pinyin: yīn wèi xià yǔ suǒ yǐ wǒ méi qù
suī rán hěn guì dàn shì hěn hǎo chī
rú guǒ nǐ yǒu shí jiān jiù lái ba

phrases.text: 我一边吃饭一边看电视
phrases.hant: 我一邊吃飯一邊看電視
phrases.pinyin: wǒ yī biān chī fàn yī biān kàn diàn shì
xiān xǐ shǒu zài chī fàn
bù dàn pián yi ér qiě hǎo chī
zhǐ yào nǔ lì jiù huì chéng gōng

drills.note: Paired connectors: 因为…所以, 虽然…但是, 如果…就, 不但…而且.

drills.title: 有点儿 vs 一点儿

phrases.pinyin: qǐng shuō màn yì diǎn ér
wǒ xiǎng chī diǎn ér dōng xī

drills.note: 有点儿 + adjective (a bit too, negative); adjective + 一点儿 (a little more).

drills.title: 也 / 都 / 还 adverbs

phrases.pinyin: wǒ men dōu shì xué shēng
tā yě yǒu liǎng gè jiě jiě

drills.note: Adverbs sit before the verb, after the subject.

drills.title: 离 / 从…到 / 往

phrases.pinyin: wǒ jiā lí xué xiào hěn jìn
cóng zhè ér dào nà ér

phrases.text: 从我家到公司要半个小时
phrases.hant: 從我家到公司要半個小時

yī yuàn lí zhè ér bù yuǎn

drills.note: 离 distance from, 从…到 from…to, 往 toward.

drills.title: Numbers 1–100
drills.note: Tens are built as 二十, 三十五, 九十九.

drills.title: Hundreds, thousands, 万
drills.note: 零 fills an empty place; 两 is used before 百 千 万.

drills.title: Money and prices

phrases.pinyin: tài guì le pián yi diǎn ér
yī gòng sān shí wǔ kuài

drills.note: 块 (kuai) is spoken yuan; 毛 is a tenth.

drills.title: Dates and weekdays

phrases.pinyin: jīn tiān jǐ yuè jǐ hào
jīn tiān shì xīng qī sān
shí èr yuè èr shí wǔ hào
wǒ de shēng rì shì wǔ yuè bā hào

drills.note: Large to small: year, month, day; weekdays 星期一…星期日.

drills.title: Telling the time

phrases.pinyin: tā wǎn shàng shí yì diǎn shuì jiào

drills.note: 点 o'clock, 刻 quarter, 半 half, 差 to.

drills.title: Day, week and year words
drills.note: Relative time words you will place before the verb.

drills.title: Tone pairs: first tone + any
drills.note: Flat first tone followed by tones 1, 2, 3, 4 and neutral: 今天 中文 开始 生日 休息.

drills.title: Tone pairs: second tone + any
drills.note: Rising first tone followed by tones 1, 2, 3, 4 and neutral: 明天 学习 啤酒 学校 朋友.

drills.title: Tone pairs: third tone + any
drills.note: Low first tone (half-third before another tone) followed by 1, 2, 3, 4 and neutral: 北京 起床 水果 感谢 椅子.

drills.title: Tone pairs: fourth tone + any
drills.note: Falling first tone followed by tones 1, 2, 3, 4 and neutral: 汽车 问题 电脑 再见 谢谢.

drills.title: Third-tone sandhi
drills.note: Two third tones in a row: the first becomes rising (你好 sounds like ní hǎo).

drills.title: 一 tone changes
drills.note: 一 is yī alone or as a number; yì before tones 1, 2, 3; yí before tone 4 (and before the measure word 个).

drills.title: 不 tone changes
drills.note: 不 is bù, but bú before another fourth tone.

drills.title: be, have and do
drills.note: The three most common verbs, as main verbs and as helpers.

drills.title: Present simple vs present continuous
drills.note: Simple for habits and facts, continuous for what is happening now.

drills.title: Past simple: common irregular verbs

phrases.text: We saw a movie last night.

drills.note: Irregular past forms: go-went, buy-bought, see-saw, eat-ate, come-came, take-took, write-wrote, know-knew.

drills.title: Present perfect vs past simple

phrases.text: I've lived here for ten years.
Have you ever been to Japan?
Did you go to Japan last year?

drills.note: Present perfect links the past to now; past simple has a finished time.

drills.title: Future: will and going to

phrases.text: I'm going to visit my parents tomorrow.
Look at those clouds, it's going to rain.
We're going to buy a house.

drills.note: Will for instant decisions and predictions, going to for plans and evidence.

drills.title: Modal verbs

phrases.text: You must wear a seat belt.

drills.note: can, could, should, must, might, may, have to, would like.

drills.title: Conditionals 0, 1 and 2

phrases.text: If you heat ice, it melts.
If it rains, we'll stay home.
If I see her, I'll tell her.
Unless you hurry, you'll miss the bus.
If I had more time, I'd learn Spanish.
If I were you, I'd wait.
What would you do if you won the lottery?
If she knew, she'd tell us.

drills.note: Zero: facts. First: real future. Second: unreal or unlikely present.

drills.title: Questions with do, does and did
drills.note: Do-support for present and past simple questions.

drills.title: Tag questions

phrases.text: You didn't call him, did you?

drills.note: Positive statement, negative tag; negative statement, positive tag.

drills.title: Comparatives and superlatives

phrases.text: This bag is cheaper than that one.
He is taller than his brother.
This is the best pizza in town.
It's more expensive than I thought.
Today is the hottest day of the year.
He's as tall as I am.

drills.note: -er and more for comparing two, -est and most for the top, as...as for equal.

drills.title: Articles: a, an, the and none

phrases.text: I'll be back in an hour.

drills.note: a before consonant sounds, an before vowel sounds, the for known things, no article for general plurals.

drills.title: Common phrasal verbs

phrases.text: Look it up in a dictionary.

drills.note: Separable verbs take a pronoun in the middle.

drills.title: Weak forms
drills.note: Small grammar words are reduced in connected speech: can, of, and, to, was, for.

drills.title: -ed endings: /t/ /d/ /ɪd/
drills.note: After voiceless sounds -ed is /t/, after voiced sounds /d/, after t or d it is /ɪd/.

drills.title: -s endings: /s/ /z/ /ɪz/
drills.note: After voiceless sounds -s is /s/, after voiced sounds /z/, after s z sh ch j it is /ɪz/.

drills.title: Word stress: noun vs verb
drills.note: Two-syllable pairs: the noun is stressed on the first syllable, the verb on the second (RECord, reCORD).
